description: This file defines the 'AuthCodeEntity' class, which implements the OAuth2 server's AuthCodeEntityInterface. It manages OAuth authorization code data including redirect URI, identifier, expiry time, user ID, client info, and associated scopes.

classes.name: AuthCodeEntity
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 authorization code data handling, maintaining properties such as redirect URI, token expiration, associated client, user, and scopes.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the auth code.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry DateTime of the auth code.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry DateTime to current UTC time + TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the auth code, if any.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Assigns a user ID to the auth code.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves the client associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the client associated with the auth code.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the auth code.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns all scopes associated with the auth code.
